competitions.subtitle: Choose the right track for your entry and check the guidelines

steps.title: How to Participate
steps.subtitle: 4 simple steps to submit your entry and receive your reference code
steps.step1Desc: Select your competition track (Report, Photography, or Passport)
steps.step2Desc: Fill in your information and university accurately
steps.step3Desc: Provide an open Google Drive link or affirm physical delivery
steps.step4Desc: Save your unique reference code to track your submission
steps.driveNoticeDesc: Ensure Google Drive share settings are set to 'Anyone with the link' with 'Viewer' permission.

universities.title: Participating Universities
universities.subtitle: Proudly partnering with top universities across all competition tracks

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to key questions about the competitions
faq.a1: Participation is open to students and supervisors from all participating universities according to each track's rules.
faq.q2: How do I make my Google Drive link publicly viewable?
faq.a2: Open the file/folder in Google Drive -> Click Share -> Under General access select 'Anyone with the link' -> Set role to 'Viewer' -> Copy link.
faq.q3: Can I submit multiple photos in the Photography track?
faq.a3: No, strictly one image is permitted inside the link. Uploading an album or multiple images may lead to disqualification.
faq.a4: Passport delivery is physical hand delivery to your supervisor with your name written on it. The supervisor confirms receipt on the platform.
faq.q5: How do I confirm my submission was received?
faq.a5: Upon form submission, you will receive a unique reference code confirming your entry has been registered.
